bug_locations: paginate: missing size validation (added ValueError for nonpositive/non-integer sizes)
paginate: missing cursor validation (added ValueError for non-string, non-integer, and negative cursors)
paginate: next_cursor computation (now None when the end of items is reached)
paginate: items handling (materialize to a list so length is known and any iterable works)
explanation: Three interacting defects: (1) size was never validated, so zero or negative sizes produced empty or nonsensical slices instead of raising ValueError as specified; (2) the cursor was parsed with int() but never validated — negative index strings like '-1' were silently accepted and Python's negative indexing returned items from the wrong end, while non-string cursors could raise TypeError instead of the required ValueError; (3) next_cursor was unconditionally str(end), so it was never null at the end of the collection. The fix validates size as a positive integer, validates the cursor as a non-negative integer string (raising ValueError otherwise), materializes items into a list, and returns None for next_cursor whenever end >= len(items).
